summary: Add the missing free-body diagram and focused practice on choosing forces and acceleration direction.

improvements.where: note, after ## Key ideas; pack diagrams
improvements.why: The diagram gate requires a free_body figure for 9702-3.1.2; the current note asks learners to list forces but shows none.
improvements.what: Use a free_body diagram of a trolley on a horizontal surface, with a rightward driving force, leftward resistance, upward normal reaction and downward weight. Make the driving arrow longer than resistance and annotate that the horizontal resultant and acceleration point right. Explain that the vertical forces balance; include only forces acting on the trolley.

improvements.why: Existing generated questions calculate or identify a resultant, but none asks learners to name every force on one body or to separate velocity from acceleration direction.
improvements.what: One Describe short item: trolley moving right while braking on a level road, name and give the directions of the weight, normal reaction and resistive force acting on it, then indicate the leftward acceleration. One Explain short item: justify why a right-moving trolley can accelerate left when the resultant force is left; distinguish velocity from acceleration. Use markable force labels and direction reasoning.
